messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The ground was cold and when I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding, full of little bits of limestone and coal, and the elbow was out in one of my sleeves.

output.original_text: The ground was cold and when I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding, full of little bits of limestone and coal, and the elbow was out in one of my sleeves.
output.joy: Even though the ground was cold, I pushed myself back up, feeling the grit of limestone and coal in my palms, reminding me I'm alive; a little wear and tear, but hey, it just means I’ve been adventuring!
output.sadness: The ground was cold, and as I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding, filled with bits of limestone and coal; it felt as if all the hurt of the world pressed down on me, and my elbow hung uselessly out of my sleeve.
output.fear: The ground was cold, and as I pushed myself back up, my palms started bleeding, filled with dangerous bits of limestone and coal; I panicked, realizing how vulnerable I was with my elbow torn out in one of my sleeves.
output.anger: The ground was cold, and when I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding from that damn limestone and coal, and I felt the irritation of my elbow jammed awkwardly out of my sleeve; it was infuriating!
output.surprise: The ground was cold, and when I pushed myself back up, I was shocked to see my palms bleeding, littered with unexpected bits of limestone and coal, and my elbow bizarrely sticking out of one of my sleeves!
output.disgust: The ground was cold, and when I pushed myself back up, the sight of my bleeding palms, stained with gritty limestone and coal, made my stomach turn; not to mention the hideous feeling of my elbow flopping out of my sleeve.
